title: Automate weekly snapshot + RC metadata assembler for release train
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Build an automated job that produces a deterministic weekly snapshot artifact and assembles RC metadata for the release train. The job should: 1) pick the candidate commit set for the weekly build using the 'anchor' branch cut rules; 2) generate an RC manifest that includes semantic version + build metadata, signed checksums, and compatibility matrix (model runtime kernels); 3) tag candidate images and create a machine-readable RC payload for downstream rollouts and the Console; 4) produce a machine + human friendly release notes draft by aggregating merged PRs and categorizing by labels; and 5) publish artifacts to the release storage and notify the release channel. This work is intended to reduce manual cut errors, make RC metadata auditable, and provide a single source of truth for rollouts and upgrade tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Weekly snapshot job runs successfully on schedule and produces a single immutable snapshot artifact (tarball + manifest) stored in releases.redwood/snapshots/
RC manifest contains: semver with +build metadata, commit list, build checksums, Sigstore signature link, and runtime compatibility tags
Release notes draft is generated automatically and includes categorized PRs (feature, fix, perf, breaking) with links and a short one-line summary per PR
CI gating verifies artifact integrity and rejects snapshot if any required integration test fails
Downstream systems (Console rollout UI, upgrade-assistant, and canary pipeline) can consume the manifest via stable API endpoint without manual intervention
updates: 2026-03-02: Kickoff sync with Eng, PM, and Docs. Agreed on minimal manifest schema and storage layout. Action: write initial schema proposal.

2026-03-04: Spike complete. Implemented prototype that collects merged PRs between anchor tags and creates a draft markdown release notes. Prototype located in https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-tools/pulls/142

2026-03-05: Design decision: use semver pre-release +build metadata (e.g., 1.20.0-rc.1+20260305.sha.githash) to preserve ordering while allowing deterministic comparison. Tradeoff: risks longer version strings vs easier automation downstream.

2026-03-06: Security review flagged Sigstore integration for artifact signing. Decided to scope to ephemeral signing keys for now; long-term will integrate KMS/HSM. Follow-up ticket created ENG-214789.
2026-03-08: Release notes composer updated to use PR labels rather than title heuristics. Edge cases found for bulk-chore PRs; added a 'manual_review_required' flag to output manifest.

2026-03-09: First end-to-end run in staging completed. Snapshot artifact uploaded to staging release bucket and manifest consumed by staging Console. Dashboard smoke tests passed except for latency spikes when compiling large changelogs (issue filed ENG-214610).
2026-03-11: Review feedback from PM (Riley Chen): include a backward-compatibility matrix for models (quantization/seq-len support) in the manifest. Updated schema draft and notified runtime team.

2026-03-12: Demo to Release Managers. They requested an opt-in 2-hour freeze window for final amendments before RC publication. We added toggle to the job. Planning to roll to prod on 2026-03-19 if no high-severity issues are found.
